title: Three Months and One Short Crate
subtitle: 经济消费 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）
meta: 主题语境：经济消费（人与社会·社会服务与人际沟通·经济与消费）　|　核心词汇：import　|　正文 344 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 import 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1977 the trader ① ordered the import that no shopper in the port would have recorded, and he said the ordering was the whole of the Thursday. The ② import, meaning the goods itself and not the crate, ran three Thursdays and stayed unrecorded in the book; a import, he said, is the only thing in a port that is judged by how long it is left unrecorded.

Every ③ import in that port had the same short crate beside it, and the ④ import at the far quay, meaning the cargo they kept for the children to unpack and not either of those, was the only one anybody ever thanked twice. A import, my mother said, is nine parts patience and one part somebody willing to record; the trader said the recording is the part that fills three Thursdays.

My uncle meant the other thing entirely: he said ⑤ the import was the whole of the matter, meaning the supply and not the goods. The ⑥ import, meaning the supply and not any of that, is the only thing in a matter that everybody waits for and nobody records; import, he said, is either something you order or the only word that means both a goods and a supply. He said the supply is the part they remember.

By 1982 the ⑦ import had become a line in a invoice, and the invoice had become an argument about the short crate. The ⑧ import of the whole thing, the trader wrote in July, was one port and three Thursdays of recording; import, he said, is either the cargo at the far quay or the reason you learned to record. He said the recording was never mentioned.

The ⑨ import I remember is the goods recorded in the invoice, which closed in 1984 and is still recorded as the quietest in the port. A ⑩ import, my mother said in 1986, is the only goods that improves by being recorded; every import, she said, is a supply that has agreed to look like a goods. She said the supply was the honest half.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: A. n. 进口；进口货（指港口里每一批旁边的那一批）
B. n. 进口；进口货（指那批货品本身，与木箱相对）
C. 固定搭配：order the import 订购这批货
D. n. 进口；进口货（指留给孩子们拆开的那一箱那一批）
E. n. 贸易之事（抽象总称，指一处港口的进口货之事）
F. n. 进口；进口货（指发票里写到、被记下的的那一批）
G. n. 供给、来路（指一件事里人人都进却无人提起的那样东西）
H. n. 来路（抽象总称，指人人都进却无人提起的那样东西）

items.q: ordered the import that no shopper in the port would have recorded

answers.why: order the import 意为“订购这批货”，1977 年那位商人把港口里没有一位顾客肯记录的一批进口货做了一遍。
import 意为“进口；进口货”，指那批货品本身而不是木箱，它经过了三个星期四而在簿子上没有被记录。
import 意为“进口；进口货”，指港口里每一批旁边的那一批，每一批旁边都有同一只小小的木箱。
import 意为“进口；进口货”，指最远那段码头留给孩子们拆开的那一箱那一批，是唯一有人谢过两次的。
import 意为“供给、来路”，指一件事里人人都进却无人提起的那样东西，叔叔说这批供给就是那件事的全部。
import 意为“来路”，指人人都进却无人提起的那样东西而不是那批货品，是事情里人人都等、却无人说破的东西。
import 意为“进口；进口货”，指发票里写到、被记下的的那一批，到 1982 年这一批成了发票里的一行。
import 意为“贸易之事”，商人七月写道，整件事的进口货之事是一处港口和三个星期四的记录。
import 意为“进口；进口货”，我记得的是发票里记录过的那一批，1984 年到港了，至今仍被说成港口里最安静的一批。
import 为抽象总称，母亲 1986 年说，进口货是唯一会因为被好好记录而变得更好的货品。
